commentary_summary: The tonne-mile index declined last week after remaining stable the week before. Meanwhile, utilisation of Handysize vessels remained steady last week at 92.8%. | The laden tonnage at anchor at China's discharge ports reached its lowest level for 2024 as activity remained subdued after the country's Golden Week holidays. | Meanwhile, congestion in India continued to be on an uptrend due to heightened coal imports in the country. Congestion levels reached the second highest for the year so far at the discharge ports as coastal activity also remains buoyant.
